summary: Describes a URN namespace for the Common Language Equipment Identifier (CLEI) code used in ANSI-standardized messages. The CLEI code is a globally unique ten-character code, and the namespace is managed by Telcordia Technologies as maintenance agent for ANSI T1.213. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Telephone equipment gets a short ID code so everyone knows exactly which gadget is meant. This memo lets those ID codes be written as proper internet names.
